g.title: SBE_QSP
g.text: Snakebite Envenoming and Antivenom — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
독사 교상 + 항독소 QSP 기계론적 지도 · 50-ODE mrgsolve model · 4 toxin classes × 3 antivenom fragment formats × 8 snake archetypes
THESIS: antivenom binds; it does not undo.
A venom clock in hours (left) drives a substrate clock in days (right); every endpoint is read off the slow one.
solid = mass flux / activation · dashed = modulation · red T-bar = inhibition · blue = drug delivery ·

g.title: cluster_bite
g.text: 1 · The bite — venom dose is a distribution, not a number
교상 — 주입 독량은 하나의 값이 아니라 분포다

g.title: cluster_prot
g.text: 3 · The venom proteome — the four modelled classes and what they do
독액 단백질체 — 모델링된 4개 계열과 그 작용

g.title: cluster_depot
g.text: 2 · Bite-site depot — absorption sorted by molecular weight
교상부 저장고 — 분자량에 따라 분리되는 흡수

g.title: cluster_vpk
g.text: 4 · Systemic venom disposition — and the deep compartment that causes recurrence
전신 독소 동태 — 재발을 만드는 심부 구획

g.title: cluster_avmake
g.text: 5 · What is in the vial — three fragment formats, three different drugs
항독소 바이알의 내용 — 세 가지 절편 형식은 서로 다른 약이다

g.title: cluster_avpk
g.text: 6 · Antivenom disposition — and the recurrence inequality

g.title: cluster_bind
g.text: 7 · Neutralisation — near-instantaneous where it works, and the two places it does not
중화 — 작동하는 곳에서는 거의 순간적이며, 작동하지 않는 두 곳

g.title: cluster_vicc
g.text: 8 · BRIDGE · Venom-induced consumption coagulopathy (VICC) — the substrate clock starts here
독소 유발 소모성 응고장애 — 기질 시계가 시작되는 지점

g.title: cluster_coagout
g.text: 9 · Coagulation read-outs — and the test that costs nothing
응고 검사 지표 — 그리고 비용이 들지 않는 검사

g.title: cluster_twopara
g.text: 11 · The two paralyses — identical bedside picture, opposite pharmacology
두 가지 마비 — 같은 임상 소견, 정반대의 약리학

g.title: cluster_nmj
g.text: 12 · BRIDGE · The neuromuscular junction — a threshold on a product, not a sum
신경근접합부 — 합이 아니라 곱에 대한 문턱값

g.title: cluster_neuroout
g.text: 13 · Neuromuscular endpoints — and what actually saves the patient
신경근 종말점 — 그리고 실제로 환자를 살리는 것

g.title: cluster_local
g.text: 14 · BRIDGE · Local injury — the compartment antivenom cannot reach
국소 손상 — 항독소가 도달할 수 없는 구획

g.title: cluster_rhabdo
g.text: 횡문근 융해 — 국소 및 전신 근독성

g.title: cluster_kidney
g.text: 16 · Venom-induced acute kidney injury — an integral, not a level
독소 유발 급성 신손상 — 수치가 아니라 적분

g.title: cluster_haemo
g.text: 17 · Capillary leak — plasma leaves the circulation before blood does
모세혈관 누출 — 혈액보다 혈장이 먼저 빠져나간다

g.title: cluster_avae
g.text: 19 · Antivenom adverse reactions — the cost side of the ledger

g.title: cluster_adj
g.text: 20 · Adjuncts and investigational agents — including what does NOT work
보조 및 연구 단계 치료 — 효과가 없는 것까지 포함

g.title: cluster_decide
g.text: 21 · The clinical decision layer — the whole model reduced to four questions
임상 의사결정 층 — 전체 모델을 네 가지 질문으로 압축

g.title: COMP
g.text: Daboia 34% PLA2 + 28% SVMP → all of it

g.title: Q1
g.text: Q1 · IS THIS AN ENVENOMING AT ALL?
A dry bite treated as an envenoming gets
all of the antivenom risk and none of the
benefit. This question is free to ask.

g.text: Q3 · WILL THE COVER OUTLAST THE VENOM?
If the fragment loses, plan a maintenance
schedule at the time of the first dose —
not after the recurrence is discovered.

g.title: Q4
g.text: Q4 · WHAT IS THE ACTUAL LIFE-SAVING ACT?
Antivenom is necessary; it is rarely enough.

g.title: Q2
g.text: Q2 · HAS THE SUBSTRATE ALREADY GONE?
Antivenom changes the DEPTH of the nadir.
It does not change the recovery SLOPE.
Late antivenom still prevents the next
few hours of consumption — but only that.
